conflicts.wo2_value: Double-anonymized (double-blind) peer review; initial editor appraisal, then review by independent anonymous expert referees, via ScholarOne Manuscripts. Source: https://www.tandfonline.com/journals/ccpq20/about-this-journal
conflicts.why_flagged: 既有值為 family-norm 推測(single-blind),WO2 從期刊官方 about-this-journal 頁面查得的是 double-anonymized(double-blind)。兩者直接矛盾,需人工核實後決定是否更新,不應由本次 patch 直接覆蓋。

conflicts.field: Review Cycle Time > Time to publication (after acceptance)
conflicts.why_flagged: 既有欄位已有具體內容(非空白/佔位符),而 WO2 提供的官方數字(8天)與既有的『2-6週』估計有實質落差,屬矛盾而非單純補充細節,依規則應留待人工判斷,不逕行覆蓋。

conflicts.field: Soft Metadata > Framing Requirements / Epistemological & Political Leanings (超出範圍,僅供人工參考)
conflicts.existing_value: 既有 Tier 2 內容偏向泛用 family-norm 描述(如 cross-cultural friendliness: Medium,無特別提及去殖民化/批判取向)
conflicts.wo2_value: WO2 positioning finding(signal_quality 4/5)指出近期(2025下半-2026)CPQ 明顯歡迎去殖民化(decolonizing)、文化回應督導、社會正義/多元文化批判框架之投稿,Vol 39 Issue 1(2026)甚至為『Decolonizing Counselling Psychology』專題特輯
conflicts.why_flagged: 此為 Soft Metadata 主觀分節(Epistemological & Political Leanings / Framing Requirements),依規則屬 out-of-scope,不可直接編輯,僅記錄供人工日後評估是否應調整 Tier 2 假設或升級為 Tier 1。
